blocks.title: Therapeutic index
blocks.text: Therapeutic index (TI) dawa ki hifazat ka miqdari paimana hai. Yeh zehreela asar dene wali khurak ka matloob ilaji asar dene wali khurak se muqabla karta hai: TI = TD50 / ED50.

blocks.alt: Graph: % age of patients responding ba-muqabla exposure. Neeli Efficacy S-curve ED50 par barhti aur gulabi Toxicity S-curve baad mein TD50 par; dashed khari lakeerein ED50 aur TD50 par. ED50 ke gird hari patti, oopar doharay teer ke saath, Therapeutic window. Neeche daen: Therapeutic index = TD50 / ED50.
blocks.caption: Figure 32.1: Therapeutic window aur therapeutic index (kitab ki Figure 32.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeli curve batati hai kitne mareezon ko faida hua, gulabi curve kitne mareezon mein zehreela asar aaya. Dono curves ke beech jitna faasla, dawa utni mehfooz. Kitab ki Figure 32.1 mein 'Therapeutic index = ED50/TD50' chhapa hai, jo ulta hai; kitab ka apna matan aur sahi formula TI = TD50 / ED50 hai (zehreeli khurak ko mo'assar khurak se taqseem). Khaake mein yahi sahi formula likha gaya hai.

items: TD50 (toxic dose 50) woh khurak hai jo lene walon mein se 50% mein zehreela asar paida kare.
ED50 (effective dose 50) woh khurak hai jo lene walon mein se 50% par kaam kare.

blocks.text: Zyada TI ka matlab hai dawa zyada mehfooz hai, kyunke mo'assar aur zehreeli khurak mein zyada farq hai; kam TI ka matlab hai dawa zyada khatarnak hai aur ehtiyati nigrani chahti hai. Maslan 10 TI wali dawa 2 TI wali se kaheen zyada mehfooz hai. Kitab penicillin aur paracetamol ko zyada TI wali dawayein batati hai, is liye ghalti se dugni khurak mareez ki jaan ke liye khatra nahi banti. Warfarin (khoon patla karne wali) aur digoxin (dil ki dawa) ka TI kam hai aur inhein bohat ehtiyat se sahi khurak mein lena zaruri hai, warna mareez ki jaan khatre mein par sakti hai. Kam TI wali dawayein lene walon ko therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) ke liye ba-qaida khoon ke test karwane parte hain.

blocks.title: Khurak phir bhi ahem hai
blocks.text: Zyada TI dawa ko zyada miqdar mein be-zarar nahi banata. Maslan paracetamol ki had se zyada khurak jigar (liver) ko sakht nuqsan de sakti hai, is liye batayi gayi khurak hamesha follow karni chahiye.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Jadeed khoon ki satah ki nigrani se pehle digoxin hospitalon mein hadsati amwaat ki aam wajah thi. Is ka TI itna kam hai ke aam ghizaon ya doosri dawaon ke maamooli asar bhi mareez ko jaan-leva 'zehreele ilaqe' mein dhakel sakte the. Is ka zehr ventricular fibrillation (dil ki jaan-leva dharkan) aur 'peela' nazar aana (xanthopsia) paida karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Dawa X ka ED50 5 mg aur TD50 100 mg hai. Is ka therapeutic index nikalein.
blocks.explanation: TI = TD50 / ED50 = 100 / 5 = 20, nisbatan mehfooz dawa.

items: Zyada TI (penicillin): mehfooz; kam TI (warfarin, digoxin): nigrani (TDM) chahiye.
